purpose: Confirmatory test of the compression results on a fresh split. Fixed before any C1 data exists.
split: data/prompts/test.json (500 COCO prompts, selection seed 20261113, image- and caption-disjoint from calibration, hold-out and validation)
allocation: all runs in one allocation, reference first; 10 warm-ups each

policies.nas_04: locked finalist: 10-step DDIM, guidance 10.5, int8, up2.attn2 removed
policies.dpm8: 8-step DPM-Solver++, guidance 7.5, fp16 (strongest training-free baseline on validation)
policies.bksdm_small_ddim10_int8: BK-SDM-small at nas_04's sampler and precision (10-step DDIM, guidance 10.5, int8)
policies.bksdm_base_ddim10_int8: BK-SDM-base at nas_04's sampler and precision

hypotheses.H1: nas_04 is non-inferior to the reference in CLIP: lower bound of the one-sided 97.5% paired bootstrap interval of (nas_04 - reference) > -0.5
hypotheses.H2: nas_01 is non-inferior to the reference in CLIP (same test)
hypotheses.H3: int8_ddim20 is non-inferior to the reference in CLIP (same test)
hypotheses.H4: nas_04 has higher CLIP than bksdm_small_ddim10_int8 (two-sided paired bootstrap, mean difference > 0)
hypotheses.H5: nas_04 has higher CLIP than bksdm_base_ddim10_int8 (same test)

multiplicity: Holm over H1-H5 using bootstrap p-values (non-inferiority p = P(mean difference <= -margin) under the bootstrap)
secondary: descriptive with 95% intervals: CLIP image fidelity to the reference, black images, KID/FID vs the reference and vs 5,000 real COCO images, latency, GFLOPs, peak VRAM, U-Net parameters and bytes; nas_04 vs nas_04_twin_int8 isolates the unit removal
